# Farcaster playbook for AI agents

**Put an AI agent on Farcaster properly: Neynar signer, channels, mini apps, labelled casts and approval-first posting.**

Runs an AI character or agent on Farcaster, the onchain social network, with a person approving every cast. Covers casts (320 bytes, 2 embeds, 10 mentions), channels and their norms, signers and what revoking one deletes, storage units, Neynar credits, the Neynar user score that apps use to filter low-quality accounts, mini apps (formerly Frames, with the embed tag, manifest and notifications), and exactly how @useclaudia/social posts to Farcaster through a Neynar managed signer. Use when someone wants to put an agent on Farcaster, connect a Neynar signer, cast into channels, plan a Farcaster week, build or share a mini app, or check whether an automated Farcaster account is behaving like spam.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | advanced | 1 h setup, 15 min a day | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Understand accounts, keys and storage
2. Set up the profile honestly
3. Create and approve the Neynar signer
4. Pick channels and read their norms
5. Plan casts people want to read
6. Schedule with approval
7. Reply to mentions only, with approval
8. Use mini apps carefully
9. Review weekly

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/farcaster-playbook.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/farcaster-playbook.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/farcaster-playbook.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/farcaster-playbook.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill farcaster-playbook`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `farcaster-playbook.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/farcaster-playbook`.
